detail: The disclosure was submitted to the NSE on 16 Jun 2026 by Tarun Sanjay Mehta in compliance with Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011. This regulatory pathway is triggered when a person acquires or is deemed to acquire shares or voting rights crossing statutory thresholds (typically 5% or multiples thereof), or upon acquiring control. The specific shareholding amount, acquisition price, and conditions precedent are not disclosed in the headline announcement but are contained in the full disclosure document filed with the exchange.
